pacing_rationale: Draft review choice: measure all 599 producer steady-clock send intervals at nominal 10 Hz, accepting 0.1 percent average scheduling variation. Keep every send time, maximum scheduling lateness and the existing 90-second whole-run bound. Require the hourly representative fan-out's actual produced_hz within 999..1002 Hz; the existing client counts all 10000 samples over a 9999-interval span, so nominal 1000 Hz reports about 1000.1 Hz. Target labels alone are insufficient.
resource_rationale: Draft review choice: limit the IOC to one CPU and 512 MiB; reject final RSS growth above 64 MiB over the measured day. Retain every CPU/RSS observation and all peaks for review rather than treating the limit as proof of a plateau.
representativeness: Draft review choice: continuous 100 Hz UInt32 scalar and 4096-element UInt32 array; each hourly interval also carries 600 full HD Mono8 frames at 10 fps and 10000 updates to 16 independent PVA clients at 1000 Hz. Exercise actual reload, backend delay and outage/recovery in the same owned runtime. This fixture must be accepted in independent Instrumentation review before merging; it does not establish limits for every production portfolio.
